blurb: The Lodge Marina offers rentals of personal watercraft, ski boats, pontoon boats, kayaks, paddleboards, and canoes. Captained cruises aboard a classic wooden boat are available. Additional services include a full-service gas dock, ice and soft drinks, and day and overnight boat slips.
